name: John Valentine
title: Software Engineer • Coding Mentor @ LEARN2EARN
bio: Welcome to my personal portfolio! I'm a versatile Software Engineer who researches and checks documentation before implementation, taking the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) as a lifestyle.

First-Class Software Engineering graduate and Vice Chancellor Award recipient with strong fundamentals in computer architecture and production-grade development. Key achievements include building WeGoComply, an AI-powered KYC/AML/TIN compliance platform for Nigerian fintechs, and winning an African Telecommunication Union (ATU) grant for an IoT Smart Farm system.

Proficient in Python, Go, and Rust (Actix Web) for robust back-end and systems programming, JavaScript/TypeScript (React, Next.js), and Solidity for blockchain/Web3 development (including decentralized banking, certificate verification on blockchain + IPFS, and Hedera Network projects). Experienced with Docker, CI/CD, event-driven architectures, secure authentication, databases, performance optimization, and AI integrations.

Proven track record mentoring developers, contributing to open-source and automation tools (e.g., Twitter bots, GitHub automations), and delivering solutions that enhance efficiency, trust, and compliance. Fluent in English, collaborative in distributed teams, and committed to lifelong learning and engineering practical technologies for emerging markets.
